fixes.rest_service: one bounded immutable acquisition worker; writer services stream every <=20ms while waiting; one retained completion; timeout remains explicit
fixes.stream_service: same single writer drains bounded FIFO batches at safe cycle/event/maintenance boundaries; no second repository writer
fixes.raw_retention: exact drained transport bytes archived in bounded PublicStreamTransportBatchV1 parquet batches before interpretation
fixes.write_cost: one batch atomic composition plus immutable identity memoization and removal of redundant valid-frame state transition
fixes.recovery: historical producer error is applied only when it belongs to the active epoch; failed writer batch requires restart
fixes.reports: read-only report worker has one bounded slot and cannot block writer or queue reruns
fixes.telemetry: service calls, frames, maximum service gap/duration and transport batch identity are exposed in source health transport evidence
